subject: Azure Marketplace onboarding — governance & technical questions
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: AtlasCloud Sales <partner@atlascloud.io>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@microsoft.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Marketplace onboarding — initial ask

Hi Liam / Atlas team,

Thanks again for taking time on the call yesterday. Per discussion we want to kick off the Azure offer creation and technical validation for Redwood Inference's SaaS offer (hosted inference API). To move efficiently, can you confirm the minimum artifacts Microsoft needs for the technical gate? From our side we plan to provide:

- SaaS offer manifest (app manifest + SKUs)
- Test plan and smoke tests for the validation team
- Publisher account ID and Azure AD tenant info
- Compliance artifacts (SOC 2 scope + data flow diagram)

I've attached a short onboarding sheet with the contact points and timelines (attachment). Jonas is looped for partner ops.

High level asks for now:
1) Confirm which SKU fields are required so our product/finance teams can align pricing format.
2) Confirm whether co-sell tagging can be requested pre-validation or only after publishing.
3) Provide available slots for technical validation next week (we prefer late PST afternoons).

Attachments: redwood-azure-onboarding-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Camila Reyes
Head of Partner Growth | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@microsoft.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, AtlasCloud Sales <partner@atlascloud.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace onboarding — initial ask

Thanks Camila — and great to meet Atlas as well. Short answers below and a few next steps to unblock technical validation: 

1) Required SKU fields: name, length unit (monthly/yearly), price (currency + numeric), billing model (metered/subscription). We can provide a template if you like.
2) Co-sell tagging: you can request co-sell enablement during publisher setup; final co-sell onboarding is gated by the GTM team post-publish, but we can tag the offer for co-sell consideration during validation.
3) Validation slots: we have openings on Tue 20 Jan 15:00–16:00 PST or Thu 22 Jan 16:00–17:00 PST. Please confirm your preferred time.

Pre-validation checklist (short):
- Publisher account ID (GUID)
- SaaS offer manifest & one example test call (curl)
- Compliance statement (SOC 2 scope, any data residency constraints)
- Contact for technical clarifications and subscription provisioning tests

If you can upload the manifest and test plan to the publisher portal and share the link, we can kick off an initial review before the live session.

Liam O'Connor
Marketplace Technical PM (Azure)
liam.oconnor@microsoft.com

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround. I've booked the technical validation for Thu, 22 Jan 2026 16:00–16:45 PST (Teams invite sent). Prior to the session, please ensure:

- Manifest is uploaded to the publisher portal and link shared (we have partial access to the manifest during review)
